title: Tanvi Sharma, HS Prannoy Progress to Vietnam Open Second Round
indian_angle: Two prominent Indian shuttlers, including top seed Tanvi Sharma, started their Vietnam Open campaign successfully by winning their opening matches.
summary: Top seed Tanvi Sharma defeated Rachel Chan of Canada 21-16, 21-17, while HS Prannoy also advanced to the second round of the Vietnam Open 2026.

title: Satwik-Chirag Reflect on China Masters Triumph, Eye Asian Games
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured a major title, building momentum for the upcoming Asian Games.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty discussed their strategy after winning the China Masters, emphasizing their strong defense and patient attack, as they now focus on defending their Asian Games title.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The national badminton body is conducting an advanced coaching course in India, aiming to elevate the standard of coaching across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The BAI has published the regulations for a key domestic team championship, which is vital for state-level competition and player development in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining the rules and guidelines for the domestic competition.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: A national coaching camp is being held in Guwahati to prepare India's junior shuttlers for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing young talent for international competition.
